text:
Maya Patel: Heads up — field request from Acme: they want a 'floor' guarantee for monthly tokens plus the ability to burst with soft credits. Need product decision on how to model this vs our current slab+addon design.
Tom Berger: Do they mean a contractual minimum or just a billing floor?
Sam Ortega (Sales): They want a contractual minimum (predictable spend) + demo spikes covered. Will sign annual if we offer a predictable burst path.
Evan Liu (Finance): We can do minimum commit. For bursts, prefer prebought credits or metered overage invoiced. Avoid open-ended free bursting — revenue leakage risk.
Rachel Singh (Legal): We'll need explicit definitions: "soft burst" (best-effort, no SLA) vs "hard cap" (enforced, SLA). Also define expiry/rollback for credits.
Alex Chen: On the infra side this maps to quota buckets + billing mapping. Proposal: three SKU components — base_commit, burst_pool (prebought or payg), and priority_lane (opt-in).
Maya Patel: Example proposal to discuss: base_commit=1,000,000 tokens/mo, burst_pool=10,000,000 tokens (prebought or PAYG toggle), priority_lane = boolean. How do we handle invoicing vs card?
Sam Ortega (Sales): Customer prefers invoice for prebought credits (annual PO). PAYG bursts okay but they'd prefer predictable prepaid credits.
Evan Liu (Finance): Prepaid credits are easiest for recognition. If invoice-based prebought credits, we need expiry term (suggest 12 months) and clear amortization.
Tom Berger: Console/Quota UX: need an obvious toggle for customers to choose "prebuy burst pool" vs "metered burst" and a per-route opt-in for priority lane. Might be ~1 sprint for quotas + 1 sprint for billing plumbing.
Alex Chen: Rough engineering estimate: quota service + enforcement changes (1.5 sprint), billing mapping + ledger updates (1 sprint), Console UI + docs (1 sprint). Integration testing and rollout ~2 more weeks.
Rachel Singh: Draft contract snippet I propose: 

"Burst Credits": Prepaid or Pay-As-You-Go credits that may be applied to usage in excess of the Base Commitment. Prepaid credits expire 12 months from invoice date. No refunds for unused credits. "

Rachel Singh: Will circulate formal language.
Evan Liu (Finance): Also propose accounting rule: prepaid credits recognized over 12 months unless otherwise required by GAAP.
Maya Patel: OK — action items: 1) Alex to open RFC with config prototype and eng estimate, 2) Rachel to draft contract clause, 3) Evan to confirm revenue treatment, 4) Sam to pilot with Acme.
Alex Chen: I'll post RFC in docs and include example config: 

```yaml
sku:
  base_commit: 1000000
  burst_pool: 10000000
  priority_lane: true
billing:
  burst_mode: prebought  # options: prebought | payg
  invoice_allowed: true
```

Alex Chen: RFC will also list telemetry needs (per-sku token counters, burst consumption metrics) and rollout gate (finance/legal signoff).
Sam Ortega (Sales): Looping Acme now, pinged their procurement.
ops-bot: RFC created — link: https://redwood/docs/rfc/2026-burst-sku-proposal (internal)
Maya Patel: Quick vote — thumbs up if you agree to proceed with RFC + pilot. :thumbsup:
Tom Berger: :+1:
Evan Liu (Finance): +1
Rachel Singh: +1
Sam Ortega (Sales): +1 — i'll confirm customer expectations re: top-up cadence.
Maya Patel: Great — will sync this into next roadmap triage.
